info.description: OpenAPI document for the runtime generic platform APIs. Registered modules become available through the generic model, document, UI contract, search, and offline endpoints. Custom module-specific controller namespaces are not auto-generated.
info.title: Orbyte Platform API

get.description: Returns admin workspace navigation and chrome state.
Runs configuration validation for the selected scope.
Returns installed module details for administration.

post.description: Creates a session and returns session metadata.

get.description: Returns login surface options for shell or external client sign-in UIs.
Lists documents visible to the current principal.

post.description: Creates a draft document using a registered document type.

get.description: Returns a document record in normal, expanded, or raw view mode.

put.description: Updates a draft document using optimistic concurrency.

post.description: Runs submit, approve, reject, reopen, or cancel through the generic document action API.

get.description: Liveness endpoint.
Lists records for the given manifest-registered model key.

post.description: Creates a record through the generic model API for the given model key.

get.description: Returns a record, its definition, and related definitions.

put.description: Updates a record through the generic model API.

get.description: Returns the offline capabilities visible to the current principal.

post.description: Returns an offline projection package for a registered offline projection key.
Returns an offline reference package for a registered offline reference key.
Accepts draft-safe offline create and update mutations in batch.

get.description: Returns organization, roles, document types, workflows, and config keys for the current principal.
Readiness endpoint with dependency state.
Lists search index definitions visible to the current principal.
Returns one search index definition.

post.description: Runs a keyword query against the index.
Runs a hybrid query against the index.
Runs a vector query against the index.

get.description: Returns the surface-aware workspace menus, actions, views, locale, default route path, and self-service API catalog for the current principal.
Returns the document summary payload used by the generic user workspace.
Returns model data for the generic user workspace.
Resolves a hash-route path into an action, view, or custom entry.
Returns the explicit self-service APIs the current principal is allowed to invoke.
Returns one registered user-surface view definition.
